title: Quasi-compact separated direct image preserves quasi-coherence on spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], and let $f:X\to Y$ be a quasi-compact separated morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], with these properties as defined in [lem-trf-space-qc-separated-etale-local]. For any quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $F$ on the small etale site [def-trf-space-quasi-coherent-module], its module direct image $f_*F$ on $Y_{\mathrm{et}}$ is quasi-coherent. Here $f_*$ denotes direct image for the morphism of ringed small etale topoi induced by $f$, with the scalar action from $\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$.

source.place: Tag 03M9 (lemma-pushforward), restricted to separated morphisms; separated implies quasi-separated since a closed immersion is quasi-compact. Ringed direct image is spaces-properties.tex equation-push-pull preceding Tag 03LV.
